acceptance: Publish descriptive artifact only if full game point/opportunity conservation, required priors and >=95% supported coverage pass.
Report period differences, Spearman stability on the identical supported player cohort and bootstrap dispersion; no accuracy/causal claim or stability threshold chosen from results.
Do not promote to points policy or player-quality rank. Failed coverage is an unavailable adjustment, not zero difficulty.
artifacts: binding.json with release/dataset/source/transform versions, facts and exact game/row membership hashes
exclusions.json including every rejected game and reason
attempts.json with every config, seed, rows/dimensions, peak RSS, wall time and stop reason
baseline-predictions.jsonl and candidate-predictions.jsonl with role and immutable target keys
model artifact, dependency versions and reproduction command
baseline_recipes: Unadjusted observed points/valid scoring opportunities with exactly the same membership.
calibration_recipe: None; descriptive measurement only. Any predictive task requires a separate preregistration.
candidate_recipes: One prior-reference centered adjustment; no tuning or predictive model.
estimand: Descriptive scoring-playtype difficulty adjustment: observed points per admitted scoring opportunity minus training league playtype-reference expected points per opportunity plus the training pooled league rate.
exclusions: Exclude scheduled/nonfinal games, mixed phases, duplicate identity/event grains, quarantined games and incompatible source policies.
Exclude rows with unknown required target/exposure fields; absent rows are never zero.
Finalize complete game membership before splitting; never split one game across roles.
feature_recipe: Actually observed playtype frequencies only; no fitted talent coefficients, neighboring-year fill, inferred labels or scenario substitutions. Freeze taxonomy before binding.
input_gates: Three complete reconciled playtype seasons with NBA identity, taxonomy/version and exact opportunity definition.

One terminal scoring opportunity per possession-ending field goal/turnover/shooting-foul trip; and-one stays one opportunity, technical FT excluded; no overlapping playtype counts or duplicated FT points.
No admitted playtype/foul-trip mart currently establishes these gates: source_blocked.
input_grains: observed points and complete foul/free-throw trip attribution
limitations: Historical reconstruction does not establish publication-time availability.
Registered design is not a trained model or a cleared source gate.
Latest seasons previously inspected cannot be advertised as unexposed final tests.
preprocessing_recipe: Fit vocabularies, centering, scaling and reference rates on training only. Unknown validation/final players get zero coefficient plus unsupported flag; no future identity or full-season prior enters an earlier prediction.
sample_policy: >=200 valid opportunities and >=10 games per player-period. Unknown playtypes/FT attribution stay unknown; display only if >=95% of observed scoring opportunities have admitted supported playtypes. Return known and unknown counts.
selection_metric: No model selection. Report game-cluster bootstrap measurement dispersion and first-half versus second-half calendar stability for adjustment and baseline; instability is evidence, not an alternate candidate trigger.
serving_policy: B26 artifacts are retrospective research only until separately promoted. Show fit/input/calibration horizons; forbid earlier-cutoff decoration by later-fit artifacts. No active points policy, forecast issuance or publication pointer changes.
target_recipe: For a player scope, observed_points/valid_opportunities - sum(playtype_count*training_playtype_mean_points)/valid_opportunities + training_league_mean_points. Each required playtype reference needs >=1000 training opportunities; no future-season frequencies or imputation.
tie_break: Prefer baseline on equality; otherwise candidate order as listed. No final-test selection.
uncertainty_recipe: Seed 2501; 200 game-cluster bootstrap resamples of held-out errors with frozen predictions, percentile 2.5/97.5 differences. For coefficients report sign/rank variation across chronological training halves; no causal confidence interval.
units: points per admitted scoring opportunity; not vendor zTS or conventional TS
